study: Topology independent ten-pair replication on M1
primary_analysis: Two-sided paired Student-t test of seed accuracy differences, alpha 0.05; support requires positive mean and p < 0.05. Report 95% t interval. Exact paired sign-flip test is a sensitivity analysis, not an alternative route to success.
practical_secondary: Report whether lower 95% interval exceeds +10 percentage points; this is secondary, not the primary gate.
stopping: All 10 fresh pairs at 1024 updates, no replacements/extensions; original five-pair study excluded from primary inference
test_gate: All 20 checkpoints complete before any final evaluation; exclude every earlier and currently reserved test allocation
failure_policy: Nonfinite optimization is reported without replacement; execution faults may resume identical checkpoint/RNG/config, with incident recorded. Missing pairs prevent complete-study claim.
scope: Confirmation conditional on the existing training/validation corpus and fixed-length substitution task, not an independent task or corpus replication. Graph and initialization remain paired; mechanism inference requires later crossed design.
machine: M1 MacBook CPU/SciPy four threads for all training and evaluation
